description:
We are a high school group with big ambitions and a will to have fun.

We strongly believe that, at this stage in life, having fun and learning are the most important parts of a challenge.

We are very interested in anything related with tech!
summary: We have developed a health tracking app that gathers health data from the astronauts, observes its evolution and signals when there are anomalies, suggesting a fix. The app has a main focus being intuitive to make it easier for astronauts to monitor their health and take action if necessary.
details: The project currently demonstrates a concept of a dashboard that takes in health information about its user, interprets it and gives suggestions if any anomalies are detected. We intend this to be able to save lives or at least make an astronaut happier because they have more security on their health. We used Godot for the app with GDScript and developed a prototype wearable with an arduino R4 WiFi. We think that the implementation of a 3D view of the issues is pretty creative. We especially considered the project being intuitive to use.
